author: Chris Montcalmo
title: Two CCBC students named recipients of Jack Kent Cooke Foundation scholarships - NewsBreak
text:
By Chris Montcalmo ,
12 hours ago BALTIMORE, MD—Two students from the Community College of Baltimore County have been named recipients of the 2026 Jack Kent Cooke Foundation Undergraduate Transfer Scholarship, one of the most prestigious academic honors for community college students in the nation.
Sanjana Gaddam and Celina De Cau were selected as part of a small group of 60 scholars chosen from a competitive national pool. The scholarship is designed to ease the financial transition for high-achieving students moving from two-year programs to four-year universities to complete their bachelor’s degrees.
The financial support will allow both students to pursue specialized career paths. Gaddam intends to use the scholarship to support her journey toward law school. De Cau plans to continue her education with the goal of becoming a neonatal and fetal surgeon.
The Jack Kent Cooke Foundation awards these scholarships based on academic excellence, financial need, and a demonstrated persistence and desire to help others. By receiving the award, Gaddam and De Cau join a network of scholars who receive not only financial aid but also comprehensive academic advising and opportunities for internships and study abroad.
